observations: Three black plastic drums with lids are shown in photo 0.
The drums appear to be made of thick, durable plastic.
The lids have a ribbed design and a central handle or latch mechanism.
The drums are placed on a tiled floor, with a mop and a broom visible in the background.
The drums show some surface wear and minor scuffs, especially on the lids.
The seller claims they are '3 Plastic Drums with Lid' and 'Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.'

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows three black plastic drums with lids.

claims.claim: Food grade, used only once for clean water. No crack, no leak, lids complete.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Drums may have cracks or structural damage not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: Close-up shots of the drum bodies and lids from multiple angles, especially around seams and base.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged or non-functional.

risks.risk: Lids may be loose, cracked, or not securely closed.
risks.proof: Video or photo showing the lids being opened and closed, and a close-up of the latch mechanism.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly not secure or leak-prone.

risks.risk: Drums may not be food-grade as claimed.
risks.proof: Label or certification sticker showing food-grade approval or material composition.

proof_requests: Close-up photos of the drum bodies and lids from all angles, especially seams and base.
Video or photo showing the lids being opened and closed.
Photo of any label or certification indicating food-grade material.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
